input.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: a richly illustrated but exceptionally clear 16:9 university workshop infographic for non-technical business students. Image 1 is an IDENTITY AND STYLE REFERENCE only, not a layout to copy. Warm premium editorial digital comic, confident ink contours, natural adult proportions, cream background, petrol, sage and amber, beautifully legible large German labels. Preserve Hugo: dark curly hair, short full beard, goggles on forehead, petrol work shirt, amber tool harness. Eve: blond bob, glasses, cream cardigan. ProfEngel: bald, glasses, small chin beard, dark blazer. Avoid tiny text, random pseudo-writing, clutter, gradients as substitutes for information, logos, watermark. Every element must convey the educational relationship. All labels correctly spelled in German. All content inside generous margins. A premium illustrated evidence card filling most of frame on a clean wooden desk, with magnifying glass, a small source document and a separate colored floorplan next to it. The card has THREE large clean horizontal rows, only exact text: first row green check icon "Belegt" with a source-page symbol; second row blue floorplan icon "Im Bild prüfen"; third row amber question icon "Nicht belegt". At the bottom three separate metadata chips: "Quelle", "Stand", "Projekt". A hand wearing a petrol sleeve places a checked small note into a memory drawer. Show the desirable outcome of a document detective exercise, not design guidelines, no student UI screenshot, no other text. Huge readable labels, calm uncluttered layout.
